description: Logged changes for one website (notes, releases from the deploy hook, Stripe price changes, Google click drops), newest first, the newest of them with a receipt (a long list leaves the oldest without one): revenue per currency, signups and visitors over the same number of days before vs after, the top mover, and a confidence label. status is waiting (under a day old), collecting (the after window is still open) or ready. Was it Google: Google's search updates and incidents of the same days are google_update notes (read-only), and each receipt's google.overlap says whether one was live on the day (at_change), only in the compared days (in_window), or none, with Google search against other channels. Overlap is timing, not proof of cause: say so. Read-only.

days.description: changes logged in the last N days, 1-366; default 90

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website
